label: models/fw_valvewheel.mdl: a valve wheel, red paint worn to steel at the rim

measured.lineup: the asset is one of A to D in lineup.png beside models/snapbug.mdl, models/w_crowbar.mdl, models/w_longjump.mdl
measured.lineupTest: asked 4 times, each in another order, which of the four was not made by Valve: judges picked D, B, C, B where the asset was C, A, B, D: passed for one of the game's

M1.reason: The outline is a valve handwheel: a ring of about twelve facets, four radial spokes meeting at a central hub, and a shaft stub, the same outline in front, back, and both side views. No part is missing or sticks out where the brief gives no other form.

M2.reason: Measured 31.9 by 31.8 across the wheel and 13 deep, against 32 across asked: within 0.2%.

M3.reason: Parts the brief implies: rim, four spokes (the front view shows two crossing bars), a hub, and the shaft through the hub, which shows as the grey stub in the left and right views. Each spoke meets the rim at four points, and the rim has the same facet count in every view. Nothing is missing. The rim's facet count is not stated in the brief, so no shape item is charged.

M4.reason: Red paint on the rim and spokes, bare grey steel on the hub and shaft, as the brief asks. The rim shows grey on several outer edge facets, which is the paint worn to steel where the brief places it.

M5.reason: The worn steel at the rim is there but reads as thin bright edge streaks on a few facets (front view, upper left and right; back view the same). It does not read as worn-through patches of paint, so the wear the brief names is faint.

M6.reason: Held at the cap the line-up sets: in the four readings the judges picked D, B, C, B where the asset was C, A, B, D. None picked the asset, so the test passed for one of the game's.

M7.reason: Upright in the front view with the wheel face toward the front; in the below and top views it is a flat bar, so it stands on its plane as a wheel on an axis. The hub is at the centre, which is where the origin sits for a valve wheel.

M8.reason: Checks pass and the solid is closed in every view that shows it. The 280 triangles are under the 422 most Valve spends on a prop of this size, so the triangle budget is met. Nothing shows open, inside out, or floating.
